title: The representation category of the quantum group of a non-degenerate bilinear form
note: Classifies the fibre functors of $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SL}_q(2))$: for $E \in \mathrm{GL}_n(k)$, $n \ge 2$, with $\mathrm{tr}(E^{-1}E^{t}) = -q - q^{-1}$, the comodule category of the bilinear-form quantum group $B(E)$ is monoidally equivalent to that of $\mathcal{O}_q(\mathrm{SL}_2)$, the fundamental going to an $n$-dimensional comodule. Consumed by the eightfold front-2 result that a fibre functor changes dimensions but not fusion rules (FibreFunctorDimensionNotCategorical.lean; fibre_functor_dimension_not_categorical_probe.py). Added 2026-09-03. Checked 2026-11-22: journal, volume 31, issue 10, year 2003 and pages 4831-4851 match the citation in Aubriot, arXiv:math/0606147 (bibliography entry [Bi1]); not read off the publisher record. The arXiv preprint is math/0111114 (v1, 2001-11-09); the earlier note gave math/0207256, which is wrong. No DOI recorded: none was found in any source read.
